records.jp: 理屈で理解するのは無理だと思うから、<CR>直感的に聞いてほしい
records.en_original: This will be difficult to understand, so I ask that you use your imagination a bit rather than rely just on logic.
records.en_auxiliary: This will be difficult to understand, so I ask that you use your imagination a bit rather than rely just on logic.
records.en: I don't think you can understand this through logic alone,<CR>so I want you to take it in intuitively.

records.jp: きららたちの生きる世界には、“システム”がある
records.en_original: The world we come from has a "System."
records.en_auxiliary: The world we come from has a "System."
records.en: The world Kirara and the others live in has a 'System.'

records.jp: システム？
records.en_original: A System?
records.en_auxiliary: A System?
records.en: A System?

records.jp: 100万年に一度という周期で<CR>“神”を決定する、それが世界システム
records.en_original: Once every million years, a "god" creates a new world System.
records.en_auxiliary: Once every million years, a "god" creates a new world System.
records.en: Once every million years, the World System<CR>selects a new "god."

records.jp: 原種と呼ばれる存在が、神――<CR>つまり、この世界の管理者の座をかけて争う
records.en_original: These are the Sephira. They are beings that battle over the position of overseer of this world.
records.en_auxiliary: These are the Sephira. They are beings that battle over the position of overseer of this world.
records.en: The beings called Sephira fight to become god—<CR>in other words, the administrator of this world.

records.jp: この世界は、神の椅子取りゲームが行われている
records.en_original: The gods are playing a game of musical chairs with our world.
records.en_auxiliary: The gods are playing a game of musical chairs with our world.
records.en: This world is hosting a game of musical chairs for the seat of god.

records.jp: 100万年に一度の椅子取りゲーム……
records.en_original: A game with one turn every million years...
records.en_auxiliary: A game with one turn every million years...
records.en: A game of musical chairs held once every million years...

records.jp: そして、その100万年に一度が訪れた
records.en_original: And the millionth year came about.
records.en_auxiliary: And the millionth year came about.
records.en: And now that once-in-a-million-years moment has arrived.

records.jp: ……でも、管理者が生まれなかった
records.en_original: ...But a new overseer wasn't born.
records.en_auxiliary: ...But a new overseer wasn't born.
records.en: ...But no new administrator emerged.

records.jp: それって――
records.en_original: Wait, you mean—
records.en_auxiliary: Wait, you mean—
records.en: That means—

records.jp: 例えば――日菜子が言うように、<CR>原種がこの世界の管理者だったとするならば……
records.en_original: Let's say that Hinako is right, that the Sephira was the overseer. That means...
records.en_auxiliary: Let's say that Hinako is right, that the Sephira was the overseer. That means...
records.en: For example—if, as Hinako says,<CR>a Sephira was the world's administrator...

records.jp: 管理者を倒してしまって、<CR>世界が管理されなくなったからおかしくなった、とか
records.en_original: If the overseer was to be defeated, there would be no one to oversee the world, leaving it out of balance.
records.en_auxiliary: If the overseer was to be defeated, there would be no one to oversee the world, leaving it out of balance.
records.en: Maybe defeating the overseer left the world<CR>with no one to manage it, and that's why things went wrong.

records.jp: 何らかの異常――バグがあって、<CR>世界システムは正常に機能しなかった
records.en_original: If some kind of anomaly—a bug—occurred, then the world's System wouldn't function normally.
records.en_auxiliary: If some kind of anomaly—a bug—occurred, then the world's System wouldn't function normally.
records.en: Some anomaly—a bug—prevented the World System<CR>from functioning correctly.

records.jp: それを受けて、システムは世界を初期化しようとした
records.en_original: In response, the System would try to reset the world.
records.en_auxiliary: In response, the System would try to reset the world.
records.en: In response, the System tried to reset the world.

records.jp: おかしくなったから初期化、か……。<CR>まるでパソコンみたいなやり方だね
records.en_original: It goes screwy, then it resets. Just like a computer, huh?
records.en_auxiliary: It goes screwy, then it resets. Just like a computer, huh?
records.en: It malfunctioned, so it reset itself...<CR>That sounds just like a computer.

records.jp: そして、初期化のプロセスに入った世界は<CR>少しずつ壊れていった。そういうことね？
records.en_original: Then as part of the resetting process the current world gets destroyed. Is that correct?
records.en_auxiliary: Then as part of the resetting process the current world gets destroyed. Is that correct?
records.en: And once the world entered the reset process,<CR>it began to break down little by little. Is that right?

records.jp: イエス
records.en_original: Indeed.
records.en_auxiliary: Indeed.
records.en: Yes.

records.jp: 世界の初期化、か……
records.en_original: So, the whole world resets...
records.en_auxiliary: So, the whole world resets...
records.en: A reset of the whole world...

records.jp: （私の世界では初期化は起こっていない。<CR>つまり、管理者とかいうやつもいるってこと……？）
records.en_original: (Nothing like that ever happened in my world. Does that mean my world has someone ruling over it?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Nothing like that ever happened in my world. Does that mean my world has someone ruling over it?)
records.en: (My world has not undergone a reset.<CR>Does that mean it still has an administrator...?)

records.en_original: (Hmm... I don't get it!)
records.en_auxiliary: (Hmm... I don't get it!)
records.en: (Hmm...? Why is that...???)

records.jp: なるほど、だから灰は人を“壊す”のか……
records.en_original: I see. So that's why the Ash "destroys" people.
records.en_auxiliary: I see. So that's why the Ash "destroys" people.
records.en: I see. So that's why the Ash "destroys" people.

records.jp: 灰は、体内を巡る活力、生命力の流れを<CR>著しく阻害するエネルギーを持った物質なの
records.en_original: The Ash is a substance which carries energy. This energy greatly inhibits the flow of one's life force and vitality.
records.en_auxiliary: The Ash is a substance which carries energy. This energy greatly inhibits the flow of one's life force and vitality.
records.en: The Ash is a substance carrying energy that severely obstructs<CR>the flow of vitality and life force through the body.

records.jp: 人間がそれを吸い込むと、発熱や咳に始まり、<CR>重症になると体内組織すら破壊される。それが灰病
records.en_original: When a person inhales the Ash, they soon develop a fever and cough. The symptoms progress until the patient's organs fail. That is Ash Syndrome.
records.en_auxiliary: When a person inhales the Ash, they soon develop a fever and cough. The symptoms progress until the patient's organs fail. That is Ash Syndrome.
records.en: When inhaled, it first causes fever and coughing.<CR>In severe cases, it even destroys internal tissue. That is Ash Syndrome.

records.jp: 突如として世界中に降り始めた灰は、<CR>出所も分からなければ、科学的説明もつかない
records.en_original: Currently, there is no scientific explanation for the origin of the Ash that suddenly began falling worldwide.
records.en_auxiliary: Currently, there is no scientific explanation for the origin of the Ash that suddenly began falling worldwide.
records.en: The Ash suddenly began falling all over the world,<CR>with neither a known source nor any scientific explanation.

records.jp: 人だけじゃない。<CR>灰は、世界そのものを壊す
records.en_original: And it's not only humans. The Ash will eventually destroy the world itself.
records.en_auxiliary: And it's not only humans. The Ash will eventually destroy the world itself.
records.en: And not only people.<CR>The Ash destroys the world itself.

records.jp: もちろん、人々は灰を何とかしようと抵抗しました
records.en_original: Of course, people tried to do something about the Ash.
records.en_auxiliary: Of course, people tried to do something about the Ash.
records.en: Of course, people resisted and tried to do something about the Ash.

records.jp: その筆頭となっていたのが、わたしたちのいた組織と<CR>AASAということですね
records.en_original: The person leading that effort became the leader of the organization known as AASA.
records.en_auxiliary: The person leading that effort became the leader of the organization known as AASA.
records.en: The two leading forces in that effort were our organization<CR>and AASA.

records.jp: ただ、その結果どうなったかは、わたしもまだ……
records.en_original: But I don't remember what came of it...
records.en_auxiliary: But I don't remember what came of it...
records.en: But I still cannot remember what came of it...

records.jp: きららも思い出せない……すまぬ
records.en_original: I also don't remember. Apologies.
records.en_auxiliary: I also don't remember. Apologies.
records.en: Kirara cannot remember either... Forgive Kirara.

records.jp: じゃあ、やっぱり灰病は治せても、<CR>灰は止められなくて、私たちはこの雫世界に……？
records.en_original: Could we be in this world because we were unable to stop the Ash from falling?
records.en_auxiliary: Could we be in this world because we were unable to stop the Ash from falling?
records.en: So even if Ash Syndrome could be cured,<CR>we still could not stop the Ash, and ended up in this world...?

records.jp: ……そうなのかもしれません
records.en_original: I think you may be right.
records.en_auxiliary: I think you may be right.
records.en: That may be what happened.

records.jp: だ、大丈夫だよ、きっと！
records.en_original: I-I'm sure we're gonna be just fine!
records.en_auxiliary: I-I'm sure we're gonna be just fine!
records.en: I-I'm sure everything will be all right!

records.jp: 聞いた感じ、灰を調べている大きな組織が<CR>二つもあったんでしょ？
records.en_original: It sounds like two big organizations were researching the Ash, right?
records.en_auxiliary: It sounds like two big organizations were researching the Ash, right?
records.en: From what we have heard, there were two major organizations<CR>researching the Ash, right?

records.jp: だったらきっと、何とかする方法を見つけてるはず！
records.en_original: With that many people they must have found some way to fix everything!
records.en_auxiliary: With that many people they must have found some way to fix everything!
records.en: Then they must have found some way to deal with it!

records.jp: ……私が原種と戦ってからだよね。<CR>全部おかしくなっちゃったのは……
records.en_original: So this is all because of our battle with the Sephira...
records.en_auxiliary: So this is all because of our battle with the Sephira...
records.en: ...Everything started going wrong after I fought the Sephira,<CR>didn't it...?

records.jp: でも、その原種はすべての人間を融合しようとかいう<CR>ヤバいやつだったんでしょ？<CR>
records.en_original: But that Sephira said it was gonna merge all humans into one being, right? That sounds like bad news to me.
records.en_auxiliary: But that Sephira said it was gonna merge all humans into one being, right? That sounds like bad news to me.
records.en: But that Sephira was trying to merge all humans<CR>into one or something, right?<CR>

records.jp: それはそれで世界の終わりって感じだし、<CR>どうしようもないよ
records.en_original: That's basically the same as the world ending. You did what you had to do.
records.en_auxiliary: That's basically the same as the world ending. You did what you had to do.
records.en: That would have felt like the end of the world too.<CR>There was nothing else you could have done.

records.jp: きっとこの場の誰が日菜子ちゃんの立場でも<CR>同じようにしたと思うよ
records.en_original: I'm sure anyone in your place would have done the exact same thing, Hinako.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure anyone in your place would have done the exact same thing, Hinako.
records.en: I think anyone here would have done the same thing<CR>if they had been in your place, Hinako-chan.

records.jp: うん……
records.en_original: Maybe...
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: 順調に情報自体は集まってる。この調子で続けていけば<CR>いつか外の世界の真実にたどり着くはず
records.en_original: We're gathering information nicely. We should soon know the truth about the outside world.
records.en_auxiliary: We're gathering information nicely. We should soon know the truth about the outside world.
records.en: We're steadily gathering information. If we keep this up,<CR>we should eventually reach the truth about the outside world.

records.jp: リフレクターはまだ残ってる。<CR>その子たちの記憶に託そう
records.en_original: There are still more Reflectors we've yet to find. It all depends on their memories.
records.en_auxiliary: There are still more Reflectors we've yet to find. It all depends on their memories.
records.en: There are still Reflectors out there.<CR>Let's place our hopes in their memories.
